description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/hotel_room_2/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/hotel_room_2/questions.pdf; its answer (3) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a room-region restriction; hard = two chained relations.
The scene is split into iref regions: region 0 is the bathroom, region 1 is the bedroom. Region-scoped questions use that split.
Only large, unambiguous objects are counted. Focus lights, light switches, taps and structural classes (wall/floor/ceiling) are excluded because they are too small or too abstract to ground reliably.
The two bathroom mirrors are not used as a count target: one is a full vanity mirror and the other a small magnifying mirror, so a human would count them inconsistently.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many pictures are above the bed?
questions.evidence: Three framed rose prints (31, 34, 76) hang on the headboard wall directly above bed 57.

questions.question: How many chairs are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: Two gray armchairs by the window (15, 53).

questions.question: How many night stands are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: One night stand on each side of the bed (50, 91).

questions.question: How many curtains are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: Two curtain panels flank the window wall (17, 45).

questions.question: How many pillows are in the bedroom?
questions.evidence: Four white pillows on the bed (14, 51, 88, 93) plus one red pillow on each armchair (22, 66).

questions.question: How many pillows are on the bed?
questions.evidence: Pillows 14, 51, 88 and 93 lie on bed 57; the two red pillows are on the armchairs.

questions.question: How many red pillows are on the chairs?
questions.evidence: Red pillow 66 sits on chair 15 and red pillow 22 on chair 53.

questions.question: How many lamps are on the night stands?
questions.evidence: Lamp 10 stands on night stand 50 and lamp 92 on night stand 91.

questions.question: How many towels are in the bathroom?
questions.evidence: Three towels hang in the bathroom (region 0): 56 on the towel rail, 77 and 90 on the towel rack.

questions.question: How many towels are on the towel rack next to the toilet?
questions.evidence: Towel rack 68 is 0.94 m from toilet 3 and holds towels 77 and 90; towel 56 hangs on the separate towel rail 2.2 m away.
